name: document-reader
description: Opt-in only — dispatch this agent only when the user has explicitly asked for a source document summarized; never proactively or by default. Use it when the user wants a source document (PDF, Word doc, Postman collection, or similar) read and distilled into a reference summary. It writes one summarized markdown file per document into a subject subfolder under .claude/docs/, and for a prose-only upstream API contract also writes the house api-specs shape to .claude/api/<service>/api-specs.md. Never modifies source files.
